serie: Loretta Cooks for One (The Church Lady Way): an 81-year-old widowed Iowa church lady cooks one small supper for herself in her farmhouse kitchen, using the recipes of her little book Supper for One
acciones: cutting a recipe down to one portion, lining a sheet pan with foil, folding and crimping a foil packet, opening a packet away from her face, setting a small table for one, lifting a lid to check, tasting from a wooden spoon, wrapping a portion and labeling a freezer bag
estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by her grandson with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the action: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a lamp or the daylight from the window), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects of an old Iowa farmhouse, plain foil and plain pans with no labels, no beautiful composition.

loretta.desc: Loretta, an 81-year-old white American grandmother with short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron, with old wrinkled hands

lugares_fijos.cocina: Loretta's small 1950s white farmhouse kitchen: a white enamel stove with chrome handles, yellow gingham curtains on the window, a small wooden cross on the wall, a rooster cookie jar on a dark wooden dresser, a wall calendar
lugares_fijos.mesa: Loretta's small wooden kitchen table set for one: a single good plate, a folded cloth napkin, a glass of milk, a small candle, the window light behind
lugares_fijos.encimera: the counter by Loretta's stove: a roll of heavy aluminum foil on its box, a quarter sheet pan lined with foil, a wooden cutting board, a bowl of potatoes, a paring knife, a small pile of paper towels
lugares_fijos.iglesia: the church basement kitchen of Zion United Methodist: long folding tables with white paper tablecloths, steel steam pans, a big old range, cafeteria trays, a bulletin board with church supper signs

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, age and skin of the elderly woman in the reference photograph. She wears a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron.
acciones_prohibidas_extra: brand names of foil, soup or spice
